outgoing.name: Europe
outgoing.excerpt: Most are patterned after 19th century American designs, though those produced for Busch Gardens have European styling.

outgoing.name: North America
outgoing.excerpt: Almost every major railway that operated in North America in the first half of the 19th century owned and operated locomotives of this type.
